title: pulse
tagline: Seamless Web3-Powered Event Curation, Ride Coordination, and On-Chain Payments for Music Festivals & Club Events
description: intelligent, event-driven ecosystem designed to transform how people discover, engage with, and navigate live music event, seamlessly blending real-time data, personalized recommendations, blockchain-enabled transactions, and autonomous systems, acting as your ultimate digital companion for live experiences
how_its_made:
Personalized Event Discovery:

    Integrates with Spotify, SoundCloud, and other music platforms to analyze user listening habits.
    Recommends events based on musical preferences, social trends, and location data.
    AI-curated “Pulse Picks” for spontaneous, high-energy experiences.

On-Chain Payment System:

    Users can pay for event tickets, rides (Uber), and even in-event purchases using crypto (BTC, ETH, USDC, USDT, GHO, AAVE).
    A small service fee (+5%) on rides and transactions when using crypto, processed seamlessly.

Integrated Mobility (Uber API):

    Request rides directly through Pulse with the option to connect existing Uber accounts or pay on-chain.
    Real-time ride tracking and estimated costs, with dynamic surge pricing notifications.

Social Sync:

    Connect with friends attending the same events.
    Group planning features with synced schedules, ride-sharing coordination, and live location sharing.

Dynamic Event Companion:

    Provides real-time updates on event schedules, artist lineups, and venue maps.
    Crowd density tracking to identify less crowded areas for food, drinks, or better views.
    Live notifications for spontaneous after-parties, secret sets, and surprise performances.

Loyalty & Rewards:

    On-chain collectibles and digital badges for attending events, redeemable for discounts, exclusive merch, or early access to tickets.

Autonomous Financial Layer:

    Smart wallets powered by AgentKit for secure transactions and on-chain automation.
    Manages real-time crypto-to-fiat conversions where needed for merchant settlements.
